label: Standard Machine
description: A standard machine-made jacket relies entirely on industrial sewing machines for all seams, canvas attachment, and finishing, producing consistent and precise results at higher speed and lower cost than hand finishing. Long structural seams — back, side, sleeves — are done by machine in virtually all jackets including bespoke, as the straight length does not benefit from hand work. The overall character is uniform and neat, but lacks the subtle organic variation and flex of hand-sewn construction, and the jacket's canvas is typically fused or machine-padded rather than shaped by hand.
